description: Give a course a personal nickname that replaces its name in your own Canvas view. Only you see it; the course is unchanged for everyone else. Undo with remove_course_nickname.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

nickname.description: The nickname to show for this course. Only you see it.

name: set_course_nickname
title: Set Course Nickname
